construction: actual continuous original conversation window; no utterance reordering, gap synthesis, silence deletion, overlap removal or speed change
selection_rule: Fixed source per language; earliest120s window after source60s with both edges inside annotation gaps by>=10ms,>=5short and>=2medium turns,>=2native annotation gaps0.1-1s,>=2speakers; KO additionally>=2interviewer turns. Selected before any natural-replay inference.

source.channel_policy: Original16k mono mixed Zoom recording, complete continuous window including all annotated overlap, laughter and uncertain speech; no separation, muting or inserted gaps.

gap_statistics.definition: Gaps in union of original annotated speech intervals, not guaranteed acoustic silence; no generated gaps.

limitations: Speech ends are common frozen energy estimates constrained by original speech annotations, not acoustic truth; overlapped voices/background can bias attribution.
Audio retains all overlapping and nonlexical activity even when lexical references are unavailable.
No listening-based acoustic adjudication or experiment-candidate-derived references.
window_candidate_definition: Chronological scan of midpoint candidates formed by pairs of original no-annotated-speech gaps120s apart; no candidate ASR outputs or recognition scores used.

boundary_statistics.policy: Both window edges lie inside original annotation gaps, not lexical speech. A continuous window can cut a nonspeech event; original event intervals remain recorded and audio is never removed or re-timed.

historical_noise.recipe: Existing frozen pink/fan-like recipe at15dB; active-speech RMS is shared energy mask of full continuous clean source window.

historical_reuse: Original natural clean window, source timing, speech-end estimates and human references recovered unchanged. EN historical rain replaced by original-profile seeded pink15; JA original pink seed preserved. Output converted from historical FLOAT recipe to PCM16.

noise.recipe: original #308 seeded FFT pink/fan-like at 15dB; active RMS over complete clean window
